analogy.rationale: NEDDylation inhibition (NAE1/UBA3) blocks cullin-RING ligase activity, causing accumulation of substrates and proteotoxic/translational stress, most similar to proteasome inhibition and other stress-response classes. It also impairs cell-cycle and DNA-replication-associated protein turnover, giving weaker overlap with DNA synthesis and CDK inhibitors.
